name: Youma Shoukan no Shinjin Kenshuu: Maria ♥
original_name: 妖魔娼館の新人研修：マリア♥
source:
In a not so distant future, full-dive VR technology has made it possible for people to travel into alternate realms. Protagonist Yuichi, known for his strong libido, frequents the adult services of a realm known as "The Manor". One day, Maria informs him that he was selected to be help Maria train for her courtesan exam, and the training is to carried out in his realm on Earth!

With a flash of light from his VR gear, and an eruption in sweet perfume, Maria materialized in the flesh ready to overwhelming his senses with fantastical other worldly pleasure!

"Don't look so surprised! I need you to give me lots of naughty training So I can become a proper courtesan
Please take good care of me, Yuichi-san! ♥"

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1896780/Mystic_Courtesan_Stories_Trainee_Maria/?curator_clanid=34565901]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“在不远的将来，全潜式VR技术使人们进入异域成为可能。以强烈的性欲而闻名的主角雄一经常光顾名为“庄园”的王国的成人服务。有一天，玛丽亚通知他，他被选中来帮助玛丽亚训练妓女考试，并且训练是在他在地球的领域进行的！

随着VR设备发出的闪光和甜美香水的喷发，玛丽亚以肉身显现，准备用梦幻般的其他世俗乐趣压倒他的感官！

“别表现得那么惊讶！我需要你给我很多调皮的训练，这样我才能成为一名合格的妓女。”
佑一桑请多多关照！♥”
